description: Same monorepo with the mobile API client pinning its host's public keys via react-native-ssl-public-key-pinning and uploads routed through that client, plus the Next.js web app's axios client in apps/web/lib/axios.ts — a browser app, where pinning does not apply. VC069 must not fire (the old rule flagged the web client because "ios" matched axios.ts and "expo" matched `export`).
